The work is the transactional side of HR: drafting and issuing employment contracts and addenda, onboarding and offboarding, keeping personnel files and the HRIS accurate, preparing the monthly payroll input, registering leave and absence in line with the Wet Verbetering Poortwachter, and handling the day-to-day questions that come from employees and managers.
